label: Marktplaats Zakelijk (Pro adverteren)
terms_note: Marktplaats API (OAuth 2.0; user authorization code + refresh, or client token) for business sellers; resources: advertisements (own ads only), images, features / purchased features / buy feature, renewal, statistics, transactions, bids, users. Rate limits: not on the pages read. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (authorization code for users, client credentials for clients — Marktplaats API 1.0/2.0)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (advertisement CRUD, feature purchase, statistics; no campaign / CPC objects) Confidence: **high** — official API docs read.
auth: 1. Register as a Marktplaats API client (business account); OAuth 2.0 authorization code (user) → access + refresh token, or client-credentials token.
2. `Authorization: Bearer`; `Accept` headers select tenant / locale (multi-tenant NL / BE).
3. Use `v2/categories/{l1}/{l2}/attributes` to learn writable fields before POSTing an ad.

endpoints.notes: title, description, price model, category, attributes, shipping

endpoints.purpose: not exposed as campaign objects (Admarkt UI)

reference.limits: - Rate limits not stated; free; Marktplaats API terms; access to own ads only.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: the Marktplaats API 2.0 (https://api.marktplaats.nl/docs/v2/advertisement.html) manages classified listings ('Through the API you only have access to your own ads': create/update/delete advertisements, purchased features, renewal, per-listing statistics, bids, orders); it documents no CPC campaigns, daily budgets or pause/resume of paid promotion, so the ads vocabulary cannot be mapped faithfully.
